title: Associate, Production Finance - India
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
   

  

 Behind every great story is a team of people enabling creators to do their best work. Our Production Finance team partners with filmmakers and production partners to bring Netflix Originals to life while ensuring financial excellence, operational rigor, and responsible stewardship of production investments.
   

  

 If you're passionate about storytelling, love solving complex business problems, and thrive in fast\-paced, collaborative environments, we'd love to meet you.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 As an Associate – Production Finance, you'll be a key business partner supporting Netflix's growing slate of original productions in India.
   

  

 This is much more than a finance role. You'll work at the intersection of finance, production, and strategy—partnering with internal teams and production companies to help productions make informed financial decisions from development through delivery.
   

  

 You'll gain exposure to every stage of the production lifecycle while helping ensure our productions are financially sound, operationally efficient, and positioned for success.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

**Partner with Productions**
* Work closely with production companies, line producers, production accountants, production auditors and internal Netflix teams throughout the lifecycle of a production.
* Build trusted relationships with creative, production, legal, business affairs, tax, accounts payable, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth financial operations.
* Support production partners by providing guidance on Netflix's financial policies, reporting expectations, and production finance processes.


**Drive Financial Excellence**
* Review and analyze production budgets, cost reports, cash flows, and forecasts.
* Monitor production spend against approved budgets and identify financial risks, trends, and opportunities early.
* Partner with productions to develop accurate Estimates to Complete (ETCs) and final cost projections.
* Perform variance analysis and communicate meaningful insights that support business decisions.
* Review invoices, funding requests, and production payments for accuracy and compliance.


**Deliver Meaningful Insights**
* Go beyond validating numbers by identifying cost optimization opportunities and operational efficiencies.
* Analyze production schedules, resource utilization, and spending patterns to proactively highlight financial risks and recommendations.
* Prepare concise financial summaries and presentations for internal stakeholders to support investment decisions.


**Strengthen Financial Operations**
* Map production costs to Netflix's Chart of Accounts and maintain accurate financial records.
* Update production data across Netflix's internal systems and reporting tools.
* Partner with auditors and production accountants to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant financial reporting.
* Help improve reporting processes, financial controls, and operational efficiencies across productions.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

 We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people just as much as they enjoy working with numbers. You are someone who is naturally curious, asks thoughtful questions, and isn't satisfied with simply reconciling numbers—you want to understand the story behind them.
   

  

**You'll Be Successful In This Role If You Have**
* 7\+ years of experience in Production Finance, Production Accounting, Production Management, or a similar role within the film, television, or media industry.
* Strong understanding of production budgeting, cost reporting, forecasting, and production accounting.
* Experience working with production companies, studios, line producers, or production accountants.
* Excellent financial analysis and problem\-solving skills with strong business judgment.
* Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Google Workspace; experience with production accounting software is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of Tally or similar accounting systems is preferred.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple teams.
* Exceptional attention to detail while maintaining the ability to see the bigger picture.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related discipline. CA or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You thrive in fast\-moving environments and enjoy solving new challenges every day.
* You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.
* You build strong relationships and enjoy partnering with diverse teams.
* You balance analytical thinking with practical decision\-making.
* You have high standards, strong integrity, and a commitment to excellence.
* You're passionate about entertainment and excited to help bring incredible stories to audiences around the world.


 Why Netflix?
   

  

 At Netflix, you'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most exciting productions in the industry while partnering with exceptionally talented people across creative, production, and business teams.
   

  

 You'll be trusted with meaningful responsibility from day one, encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, and empowered to make an impact on how world\-class stories are produced.
   

  

 If you're excited by the idea of combining finance, strategy, and storytelling, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.
   

  

 We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

**Who We Are**
 Sanctuary is building something most real estate companies aren't even trying to build: wellness\-focused, nature\-integrated home communities across the Texas Hill Country, designed around the idea that where you live should make you healthier, calmer, and more connected. And now we're scaling the capital engine behind it.
   

  

 This is a company in build mode. You'd be joining early enough to shape how we finance growth for years to come, not stepping into a process that's already set in stone.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We're hiring an Associate to structure and execute debt for our US real estate portfolio \- construction, bridge, and permanent financing across multifamily, commercial, and ground\-up development. This is not a corporate credit, project finance, or loan servicing role: every transaction you'll work on is tied to a specific US property, and you'll be underwriting, structuring, and negotiating real loans against real collateral, not modeling hypotheticals.
   

  

 You'll report directly to the Capital Lead and work closely with our CEO to determine how we finance and scale our real estate pipeline.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Deal structuring \& execution: Underwrite and structure construction, bridge, and mezzanine financing for specific US assets. Take term sheets apart and put them back together to win on pricing, leverage, and flexibility.
* Capital modeling: Build the models that drive real decisions — DSCR, LTV, LTC, IRR, debt yield, stress\-tested against rate moves, lease\-up delays, cost overruns.
* Capital stack strategy: Recommend how we fund specific projects, balancing cost of capital against risk and timeline.
* Lender relations \& syndication: Be a real point of contact for US lenders and institutional capital partners. Run the diligence process and drive facilities to close.
* Portfolio surveillance: Own the debt maturity ladder across the portfolio and keep every DSCR, LTV, and LTC covenant in view before it becomes a problem.


**What You Bring**
* 3–8 years in real estate capital markets, real estate private equity, CRE lending, or real estate investment banking.
* A specific US commercial real estate deal you can walk us through in detail, the property, the structure, the numbers you calculated, and why.
* Excel and Google sheets mastery, including built debt waterfalls; VBA or Power Query is a strong plus.
* Real working knowledge of US credit agreements, loan documentation, and institutional underwriting standards for real estate.
* The ability to turn dense underwriting into a memo an executive can act on in five minutes.
* Minimum 6\-hour daily overlap with US Central Time.


**Not the right fit if:** 
 your background is loan servicing, reconciliation, back\-office operations, or ratings/research without direct property\-level underwriting. We'd rather point you toward a role that's a better match than waste your time or ours.
   

  

**Why join now**
* Real stakes, real speed. You're not modeling hypotheticals \- you're advising directly on how we move millions of dollars to build communities that are already going up.
* A seat at the table. Direct exposure to senior leadership and the institutional lenders who fund our growth.
* Build the function, not just the deals. We don't have a Senior Capital Markets hire yet \- you'd be the first person to lay the groundwork for how this function works at Sanctuary.
* Total ownership. We hand you real runway to improve how we underwrite and close, not a script to follow.
* Mission you can feel. You're financing homes designed to make people's lives measurably better \-v not another spec subdivision.
